import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int[] DX = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static final int[] DY = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static final long INF = 1_000_000_000_000_000_000L;

    static class Edge {
        int from;
        int to;
        long cap;
        long flow;

        Edge(int f, int t, long c) {
            from = f;
            to = t;
            cap = c;
            flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        int n;
        int src;
        int dst;
        List<Edge> e;
        List<List<Integer>> g;
        int[] lvl;
        int[] ptr;
        Queue<Integer> q;

        Dinic(int nodes, int s, int t) {
            n = nodes;
            src = s;
            dst = t;
            g = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            lvl = new int[n];
            ptr = new int[n];
            q = new LinkedList<>();
        }

        void link(int u, int v, long c) {
            e.add(new Edge(u, v, c));
            e.add(new Edge(v, u, 0));
            g.get(u).add(e.size() - 2);
            g.get(v).add(e.size() - 1);
        }

        boolean bfsLayer() {
            Arrays.fill(lvl, -1);
            lvl[src] = 0;
            q.offer(src);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int id : g.get(u)) {
                    Edge ed = e.get(id);
                    if (ed.cap - ed.flow > 0 && lvl[ed.to] == -1) {
                        lvl[ed.to] = lvl[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(ed.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return lvl[dst] != -1;
        }

        long dfsPush(int u, long flow) {
            if (u == dst) return flow;
            for (int i = ptr[u]; i < g.get(u).size(); i++) {
                ptr[u] = i;
                int id = g.get(u).get(i);
                Edge ed = e.get(id);
                if (lvl[ed.to] == lvl[u] + 1 && ed.cap - ed.flow > 0) {
                    long pushed = dfsPush(ed.to, Math.min(flow, ed.cap - ed.flow));
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        ed.flow += pushed;
                        e.get(id ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long fordFulkerson() {
            long total = 0;
            while (bfsLayer()) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                long pushed;
                while ((pushed = dfsPush(src, INF)) > 0) {
                    total += pushed;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    static int n, T;
    static String[] gridA = new String[15];
    static String[] gridB = new String[15];
    static int[][] distGrid = new int[15][15];

    static boolean safe(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && c >= 0 && r < n && c < n && gridA[r].charAt(c) != 'Y' && gridA[r].charAt(c) != 'Z';
    }

    static void floodFill(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(distGrid[i], -1);
        }
        Queue<int[]> qu = new LinkedList<>();
        qu.offer(new int[]{sx, sy});
        distGrid[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!qu.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = qu.poll();
            int x = cell[0];
            int y = cell[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + DX[d];
                int ny = y + DY[d];
                if (safe(nx, ny) && distGrid[nx][ny] == -1) {
                    distGrid[nx][ny] = distGrid[x][y] + 1;
                    qu.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (distGrid[i][j] == -1) {
                    distGrid[i][j] = 1000000000;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[][][][][] memoTable = new int[65][12][12][12][12];
    static int[][][][][] memoFlag = new int[65][12][12][12][12];

    static boolean canAttain(int curTime, int fromX, int fromY, int toX, int toY) {
        if (distGrid[fromX][fromY] < curTime) return false;
        if (fromX == toX && fromY == toY) return true;
        if (curTime >= T) return false;
        if (distGrid[fromX][fromY] <= curTime) return false;
        if (memoFlag[curTime][fromX][fromY][toX][toY] == 1) {
            return memoTable[curTime][fromX][fromY][toX][toY] == 1;
        }
        memoFlag[curTime][fromX][fromY][toX][toY] = 1;
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
            int nx = fromX + DX[d];
            int ny = fromY + DY[d];
            if (nx < 0 || nx >= n || ny < 0 || ny >= n) continue;
            if (gridA[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Y' || gridA[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Z') continue;
            if (canAttain(curTime + 1, nx, ny, toX, toY)) {
                memoTable[curTime][fromX][fromY][toX][toY] = 1;
                return true;
            }
        }
        memoTable[curTime][fromX][fromY][toX][toY] = 0;
        return false;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            gridA[i] = sc.next();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            gridB[i] = sc.next();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (gridA[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    floodFill(i, j);
                    goto_skip_to_z:
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        List<int[]> sourcePoints = new ArrayList<>();
        List<int[]> sinkPoints = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (gridA[i].charAt(j) != 'Z' && gridA[i].charAt(j) != 'Y' && gridA[i].charAt(j) != '0') {
                    sourcePoints.add(new int[]{i, j});
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (gridB[i].charAt(j) != 'Z' && gridB[i].charAt(j) != 'Y' && gridB[i].charAt(j) != '0') {
                    sinkPoints.add(new int[]{i, j});
                }
            }
        }

        int M = sourcePoints.size() + sinkPoints.size() + 2;
        Dinic flow = new Dinic(M, 0, M - 1);
        flow.e = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < sourcePoints.size(); i++) {
            long capacity = gridA[sourcePoints.get(i)[0]].charAt(sourcePoints.get(i)[1]) - '0';
            flow.link(0, i + 1, capacity);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < sinkPoints.size(); i++) {
            long capacity = gridB[sinkPoints.get(i)[0]].charAt(sinkPoints.get(i)[1]) - '0';
            flow.link(sourcePoints.size() + 1 + i, M - 1, capacity);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < sourcePoints.size(); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < sinkPoints.size(); j++) {
                if (canAttain(0, sourcePoints.get(i)[0], sourcePoints.get(i)[1], sinkPoints.get(j)[0], sinkPoints.get(j)[1])) {
                    flow.link(i + 1, sourcePoints.size() + 1 + j, 10000000L);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(flow.fordFulkerson());
    }
}
